name: Puddlejack
description: A puddle that jumped back. Puddlejack lurks by doorsteps waiting for someone to step too close, then leaps aside at the last second, cackling in ripples. It collects lost boot prints, wears the rain like a jacket, and treats every dry day as a personal insult to be corrected with enthusiasm.
teenDescription: Splashes first, giggles second, dries never.
adultDescription: A rain spirit in a puddle-brim hat, always mid-prank.
